5. write 150 correct words on a well-known, formal or informal subject;
6. support a prepared conversation of 12 minutes;

blocks.text: 10.3 The rule of decision
1. Default: Egyptian. Choose it if the answers 1–4 they do not clearly indicate another region. It's the course plan recommendation.
2. Levantino if the answer 3 indicates Syria, Lebanon, Jordan or Palestine, or if in the answer 4 you have stable occasions for conversation in Levant.
3. A Maghreb variety as first choice only if the answers 2–4 clearly indicate a country of
Maghreb; otherwise remains the second variety, only in understanding, from B2.
4. Iraqi or Gulf only with a specific assignment already planned.

5. In case of doubt, choose the Egyptian: the choice can be reviewed at the end of B1 without losing the job done, why the fuṣḥā remains the core. Write the decision in the register (sheet 93) with a statement of reasons.
10.4 Anti-interference rules
• Separate Anki decks, with labels [MSA] and [EGY] (or variety chosen); never the two forms on the same paper, except in comparison cards.
• For each point of dialect grammar, a contrast table with the fuṣḥā (such as section 7 of A2-23).

• You always write in fuṣḥā, except in explicit reading exercises of the written dialect.

⁧فِي تُونِسَ!⁩

exercises.title: Exercise 9 · Prepared interview (12 minutes, with tutor)
exercises.instruction: Read the delivery and prepare your answer.

blocks.text: Prepare the arguments, then speak without reading:
1. presentation: who you are, what work you do, how much you study Arabic and why (2 minutes);
2. tale: a journey or an episode of the past (3 minutes);
3. comparison: two cities or two countries you know (2 minutes), with comparisons;
4. role-playing game chosen by the tutor: at the door, at the hotel, by the doctor, on the phone (3 minutes);
5. your choice of dialect and why (2 minutes).
The tutor evaluates with the address book 6.3 (Accessories, Fluidity, Understanding, Pronunciation, Register, 1–4).

Script S · Simulation, part B (to be read)
B1 · News. Invented news. Two ratings.
⁧أَهْلًا بِكُمْ فِي نَشْرَةِ الأَخْبَارِ. اُفْتُتِحَتْ صَبَاحَ اليَوْمِ فِي مَدِينَةِ الأُقْصُرِ مَكْتَبَةٌ عَامَّةٌ جَدِيدَةٌ لِلْأَطْفَالِ،⁩
⁧فِيهَا أَكْثَرُ مِنْ عِشْرِينَ أَلْفَ كِتَابٍ. وَقَالَ مُدِيرُ المَكْتَبَةِ إِنَّهَا سَتَكُونُ مَفْتُوحَةً كُلَّ يَوْمٍ مَا عَدَا الجُمُعَةَ.⁩
⁧وَقَعَ أَمْسِ حَادِثٌ عَلَى الطَّرِيقِ السَّرِيعِ بَيْنَ مِيلَانُو وَتُورِينُو بِسَبَبِ الضَّبَابِ، وَأُصِيبَ ثَلَاثَةُ أَشْخَاصٍ⁩
⁧بِجُرُوحٍ خَفِيفَةٍ. وَوَفْقًا لِلشُّرْطَةِ، أُغْلِقَ الطَّرِيقُ سَاعَتَيْنِ.⁩
⁧وَإِلَى حَالَةِ الطَّقْسِ: مِنَ المُتَوَقَّعِ أَنْ يَكُونَ الجَوُّ غَدًا مُشْمِسًا وَمُعْتَدِلًا، وَأَنْ تَصِلَ دَرَجَةُ الحَرَارَةِ إِلَى⁩
⁧اثْنَتَيْنِ وَعِشْرِينَ دَرَجَةً.⁩

⁧اُفْتُتِحَتْ⁩ • has been inaugurated ⁧الأُقْصُر⁩ Luxor ⁧مَا عَدَا⁩ With the exception of: ⁧الطَّرِيقُ السَّرِيعُ⁩ The motorway is located in the centre of the city. ⁧الضَّبَاب⁩ • • mist • ⁧مُشْمِس⁩ Sunny. B2 · Detail. Each sentence is read three times: whole, with groups of words with pause, again whole.
⁧١. سَافَرَتْ مَارِيَا إِلَى القَاهِرَةِ فِي الصَّيْفِ، وَدَرَسَتِ العَرَبِيَّةَ فِي مَرْكَزٍ لِلُّغَاتِ.⁩
⁧٢. قَالَ المُدِيرُ إِنَّ الاِجْتِمَاعَ القَادِمَ سَيَكُونُ يَوْمَ الخَمِيسِ صَبَاحًا.⁩
Exercises

Exercise 1. Personal work: check with the section table 2 and with Appendix B. Exercise 2. a) With her colleague Maria, for an intensive course in a language centre; On arrival the suitcase was not there (they had changed plane to Rome): it arrived the next day, as the clerk had said. b) In the morning four hours of fuṣḥā with the teacher Munā (-Umm) Yūsuf"The language is not only learned in books, but also on the streets."
